parameters.query:
-- Which countries to fetch today: those with no snapshot, then the oldest
-- past DISCOVERY_OSM_REFRESH_DAYS, at most DISCOVERY_OSM_REFRESH_PER_DAY.
--
-- The map changes slowly and every query is a whole country, so asking every
-- morning bought nothing and cost the public instance: on 2026-09-24 it
-- refused connections from this IP on every backend and port. No rows means
-- nothing is due, and the workflow ends here.
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j)
SELECT c.iso
FROM p, unnest(string_to_array(upper(regexp_replace(p.j ->> 'countries', '\s', '', 'g')), ',')) WITH ORDINALITY AS c(iso, ord)
LEFT JOIN osm_snapshot s ON s.country = c.iso
WHERE c.iso ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
  AND (s.country IS NULL OR s.fetched_at < now() - make_interval(days => (p.j ->> 'refresh_days')::int))
ORDER BY s.fetched_at NULLS FIRST, c.ord
LIMIT (SELECT (j ->> 'per_day')::int FROM p);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ countries: String($env.DISCOVERY_OSM_COUNTRIES ?? ''), refresh_days: Number($env.DISCOVERY_OSM_REFRESH_DAYS || 7), per_day: Number($env.DISCOVERY_OSM_REFRESH_PER_DAY || 3) }) }}

nodes.name: Fetch OSM
nodes.notes: The public Overpass instance refuses connections or answers 504 under load; five tries five seconds apart. A country that still fails is answered from osm_snapshot by OSM Snapshot, so a bad morning costs nothing.

parameters.query:
-- Keep a complete response as the country's snapshot. A failure writes
-- nothing, so the country stays due and is asked again tomorrow, while WF-01
-- goes on using the last good snapshot. osm_snapshot is 0020.
WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
saved AS (
    INSERT INTO osm_snapshot (country, payload, elements, fetched_at)
    SELECT j ->> 'iso', j ->> 'data', (j ->> 'elements')::int, now()
    FROM p
    WHERE coalesce(j ->> 'data', '') <> ''
    ON CONFLICT (country) DO UPDATE
        SET payload = EXCLUDED.payload, elements = EXCLUDED.elements, fetched_at = now()
    RETURNING country, elements
)
SELECT (SELECT j ->> 'iso' FROM p)     AS iso,
       (SELECT elements FROM saved)    AS elements,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved)    AS saved,
       (SELECT j ->> 'problem' FROM p) AS problem;
